title: Ayushman Bharat - Free Health Insurance
source: Ministry of Labour & Employment, PM-JAY Official

chunks.title: PM-JAY Program - Free Hospital Care
chunks.content: Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY / Ayushman Bharat) provides FREE health insurance covering hospitalization up to ₹5 lakh/family/year to:40 crore (entire poorer section) Indian families. Covered under SECC (Socio-Economic Caste Census) database, APL landless families, NREGA workers. Registration: Check eligibility at www.pmjay.gov.in or visit nearest empaneled hospital/health center. Generate referral ID (free). Benefits: ALL hospital charges covered (no out-of-pocket expense), treatment at 50,000+ hospitals (government + private empaneled), surgeries, medicines, diagnostics, pre+post-hospitalization costs.

chunks.title: Eligible Diseases & Coverage
chunks.content: Covers 1,393 procedures including: (1) Surgery - appendectomy, hernia, cataract, hysterectomy, (2) Medicine - cancer treatment, dialysis, cardiac surgery, (3) Hospitalization - admission charges, bed, anesthesia, operation theater, medicine, blood transfusion, (4) Pre-hospitalization diagnostics (1 month before), (5) Post-hospitalization follow-up (15 days after discharge). NOT covered: Outpatient treatment (not related to hospitalization), fertility treatment, cosmetic surgery, alcohol rehabilitation. Excluded conditions: Injury from drinking alcohol, risky activities. Check full MCR (Medical Cost Rule) for specifics.

chunks.title: How to Use PM-JAY Card
chunks.content: Steps to get free treatment: (1) Check eligibility online at pmjay.gov.in using phone/SECC ID, (2) If eligible, visit nearby empaneled hospital, (3) Hospital prepares benefit eligibility document (FREE), (4) Get card generated on-site (takes 15 mins), (5) Proceed with treatment - zero cost to you, (6) Hospital gets paid by PMJAY directly. No need to carry original documents - digital authentication sufficient. Cards valid 1 year, renewed annually. Lost card? Get duplicate same-day at hospital. Keep prescription/discharge summary for records.

chunks.title: Government Health Centers & AB-HWC
chunks.content: Health centers strengthened under Ayushman Bharat: (1) Health & Wellness Centers (AB-HWCs) - every village gets health check-up center for blood pressure, blood sugar, cholesterol, weight check (free), (2) Primary Health Centers (PHCs) - handle normal deliveries, basic surgeries, lab tests (free), (3) Community Health Centers (CHCs) - district hospitals with specialists, complicated deliveries, surgeries. All services FREE for poor families. Registration: Simple - provide name + Aadhaar. Can walk-in, no appointment needed.

chunks.title: Grievances & Helpline
chunks.content: If problem with treatment/payment: (1) Contact hospital patient grievance cell immediately, (2) Call PMJAY helpline 1800-111-565 (toll-free), (3) File complaint online at pmjay.gov.in, (4) Contact district PM-JAY coordinator. Common issues: Hospital refusing treatment (illegal - escalate immediately), charges asked (report to helpline), card not working (call support). Response time: 24-48 hours for resolution. No bribery needed - system is fully digital. If treated unfairly, you have right to file RTI (Right to Information) + legal action.
